map.输入广告花费与带来的收入，评估广告投放效果: Enter ad spend and the revenue it generated to evaluate campaign performance
map.📖 查看「广告ROI计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Ad ROI Calculator User Guide"
map.ROI = (广告收入 - 广告花费 - 商品成本) / 广告花费 × 100%: ROI = (ad revenue - ad spend - product cost) / ad spend × 100%
map.ROAS = 广告收入 / 广告花费，通常 ROAS > 1 表示广告未亏损: ROAS = ad revenue / ad spend; ROAS > 1 usually means the campaign is not losing money
map.CPA = 广告花费 / 转化数，表示每获取一个转化的成本: CPA = ad spend / conversions, the cost of acquiring one conversion
map.商品成本率用于估算真实利润，未考虑运营、人力等其他费用: The product cost rate estimates true profit and excludes operating, labor and other expenses
map.📚 深度解析：广告 ROI 简明计算: 📚 In-depth: Ad ROI in a Nutshell
map.活动结束后快速核算这笔投放到底赚没赚、每单获客成本多少。: Reconcile a campaign after it ends to see whether it made money and what one acquisition cost
map.给老板做一页纸汇报时用最简口径（花费/收入/货成本/转化）。: Use the simplest view (spend / revenue / goods cost / conversions) for a one-page management report
map.多活动横向对比，按: Compare campaigns side by side and rank by
map.与 CPA 排序砍掉低效投放。: and CPA to cut underperforming placements
map.花费 10000、收入 30000、转化 100、货成本率 40% → 货成本: Spend 10000, revenue 30000, conversions 100 and goods cost rate 40% gives goods cost 12000 and profit 8000;
map.活动 A：花费 8000、收入 24000、转化 120；活动 B：花费 120: Campaign A: spend 8000, revenue 24000, conversions 120; Campaign B: spend 12000, revenue 30000, conversions 90. A's CPA of 66.7 beats B's 133, so shift budget toward A.
map.为什么利润要扣货成本？: Why deduct goods cost from profit?
map.收入不是利润，卖货还要付进货/生产成本。不扣货成本会把 ROI 算高，误导预算决: Revenue is not profit, since selling goods means paying purchase or production cost. Skipping goods cost inflates ROI and misleads budget decisions.
map.ROI 和 ROAS 哪个更该看？: Which matters more, ROI or ROAS?
map.ROAS 看广告效率，ROI 看真实盈利。长期决策应优先 ROI，ROAS 仅作: ROAS shows advertising efficiency while ROI shows true profitability. For long-term decisions prioritize ROI and use ROAS only for real-time campaign monitoring.
